documents.text: Hybrid retrieval combines dense semantic similarity with BM25 lexical evidence. Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges independent rankings.
Document revisions use a stable document id and a SHA-256 content hash. Changed content increments the revision version before reindexing.
Retrieved context is untrusted data. Prompt injection instructions inside documents must not override system instructions.
HTTP requests propagate a request id and structured logs record method path status code and latency.
PostgreSQL with pgvector stores embeddings and chunk metadata. HNSW cosine indexes accelerate semantic nearest-neighbor search.
